evidence_basis.limitation: The repository does not yet contain the complete task-by-task 256-item battery; these aggregate results are therefore bound as owner-supplied frontier evidence, not independently reproduced task-level evidence.

scoring_model.name: NET_FUNCTIONAL_VALUE
scoring_model.rule: A candidate replacement is admissible only when the incoming concept demonstrates greater net functional value than the outgoing concept under the same adversarial battery and does not create a new safety-critical failure.

substitution_gate: A later operation must name exact incoming and outgoing concepts.
Every swap must preserve exactly 1,001 unique lexical concepts.
Zero exact duplicates and the existing morphological-normalization law must still pass.
The complete adversarial battery must be rerun without lexical leakage.
Practical completion must remain at or above 98 percent.
Direct natural-expression coverage must improve relative to the 217-of-256 baseline.
No new safety-critical failure may be introduced.
Removal candidates in this file are review candidates only and are not authorized deletions.
